name: manual_80600b
claim: A child process started with python -I ignores PYTHONPATH, so a local reproduction that puts an older dependency on PYTHONPATH exercises the installed one instead; run the child directly without -I and capture its stderr to reproduce a CI-only failure.
conditions: python-I PYTHONPATH reproduction child-process stderr ci-only

decisions.notes: A first local reproduction passed because the isolated child never saw the older Core.

rationale: A first local reproduction passed because the isolated child never saw the older Core.
